name: Felstone Field
summary: Scourge corruption has claimed Felstone Field in the northwestern Western Plaguelands. Once farmland for Lordaeron, it now lies in ruins beneath a plague cauldron that sends toxic fumes into the air.

sections.title: A Blighted Homestead
sections.body: Felstone Field once fed Lordaeron from a peaceful family farm. When plague swept through the north, the Cult of the Damned and the Scourge quickly seized the homestead. Dead weeds and rot cover the fields now. At the farm’s heart, an enormous plague cauldron churns foul vapors into the sky. Cauldron Lord Bilemaw guards it with skeletal flayers, sorcerers, and ravenous ghouls.

sections.title: Lingering Ghosts and Zealots
sections.body: Traces of the living world remain among the ruins. In the northeastern farmhouse, Janice Felstone’s ghost wanders the shell of her former home in sorrow. Scarlet Crusade patrols prowl the property’s borders. They violently purge any undead they find and strike down outsiders who venture too close to their crusade.

faq.q: What is the cauldron in the center of the field doing?
faq.answer: The cauldron is a Scourge plague engine that spreads pestilence through the surrounding land and air. It corrupts the soil and raises the dead. Cauldron Lord Bilemaw guards it with skeletal minions and ghouls.

faq.q: Who is the ghost inside the farmhouse?
faq.answer: The ghost is Janice Felstone, the farmstead’s former mistress. She died when the Scourge overran the territory, and her spirit remains tied to her family’s house, unwilling or unable to rest.

faq.q: Why are there Scarlet Crusaders patrolling the farm?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade sends aggressive strike teams into the Western Plaguelands to destroy the Scourge. They treat Horde and Alliance travelers who trespass as possible plague-bearers or enemies, and attack them on sight.

faq.q: Who actually owns the deed to Felstone Field?
faq.answer: Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and Ol' Emma in Stormwind both claim their sister, Janice Felstone, gave them the deed. Whether two deeds were drawn up or the plague’s chaos tangled the inheritance between living and undead family members remains a mystery.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can see in this ruined farm a reminder of the lives your people once led in Lordaeron. Relatives such as Jeremiah Payson survived only through undeath.
As an Alliance survivor in Stormwind, you may see Felstone Field as lost ancestral land and displaced kin. Ol' Emma still claims a ruined inheritance in the north.
